name: slembcke/Chipmunk2D
description: Simple, lightweight, fast and portable 2D rigid body physics library written in C, used in hundreds of shipped games. Features multithreaded solver, ARM NEON optimizations, and comprehensive joint/constraint support.
score_rationale: 2.4k-star battle-tested 2D physics library used in hundreds of shipped games, providing quality physics accessible to C developers.
summary: Lightweight 2D physics library used in hundreds of shipped games
